title: Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) Renewal Conditions
content:
An **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** policy renews term by term on these conditions.

**Offer.** Tidemark issues the renewal offer the tier's renewal offer period in calendar days before the term end, rated on the schedule in force for the coming term with the state tax rates in force on the renewal date.

**Binding.** The renewal is bound only when full payment and current underlying evidence are received on or before the term end; because renewal payment must be received by the term end, there is no grace period, and a policy not renewed by the term end expires and can be replaced only by a new application with a new waiting period.

**Non-renewal.** Tidemark may non-renew only by written notice mailed to the insured at least the tier's non-renewal notice period in calendar days before the term end.

## The term-end boundary

| Full payment and current underlying evidence received | Result |
|---|---|
| Both on or before the term end, including on the term end itself | the renewal is bound |
| Either received only after the term end | the policy expires; only a new application with a new waiting period replaces it |

## The non-renewal notice, counted (hypothetical dates)

With a 45-day notice period and a term ending on 30 September, a notice mailed on 16 August gives exactly 45 days and is in time; a notice mailed on 17 August gives 44 days and is not.
